mcqs.question: Which ministry is scheduled to launch the ‘Koyla Shakti’—Smart Coal Analytics Dashboard (SCAD) on 29 October 2025?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Coal is scheduled to launch ‘Koyla Shakti’—Smart Coal Analytics Dashboard (SCAD) on 29 October 2025. The Ministry of Railways, Ministry of Power and Ministry of Ports are among the entities whose data the dashboard will integrate, not the launching ministry.
